summary: If OIDC login fails because the IdP rejects the default scopes, add IGNORE_DEFAULT_SCOPE: True to the authenticator's Additional Authenticator Fields so only your defined scopes are sent.
questions: OIDC login fails with unsupported scope
How do I stop AAP adding the default OIDC scope?

answer_card.title: OIDC scope mismatch
answer_card.answer_md:
Edit the OIDC authenticator and add to *Additional Authenticator Fields* (YAML or JSON, on its own line):
```yaml
IGNORE_DEFAULT_SCOPE: True
```
Only the scopes you defined are then requested.
